subject: dym-spt
title: DYM.SPT.------AFI.
description: Chart on book p. 175 (UPB(II)-37). DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) and AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree). From AFI-2: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From AFI-1: COS-D (cosmic dictates). From PHY-U-P: SOC-RT (social reality). From COS-D: TR (transformation). From SOC-RT: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From TR: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: PART (participation). From ACC-DY: RT-DY (reality dynamics).
